Bill.BriefDescription: Creating greater transparency in the decision-making processes of port districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating greater transparency in the decisionmaking processes of port districts; and amending RCW 53.12.245.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 53.12.245 and 1955 c 348 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The port commission shall organize by the election of its ownmembers of a president and secretary((, shall by resolution adopt rulesgoverning the transaction of its business)) and shall adopt an officialseal. All proceedings of the port commission shall be by motion orresolution recorded in a book or books kept for such purpose((, which))and shall also be recorded electronically, and all such recordingsshall be public records. (2) In addition to the requirements set forth in the open publicmeetings act, chapter 42.30 RCW, port commission proceedings must meetthe following notice requirements: (a) The public must be provided with ample advance notice of thedate, time, place, and subject matter of regular meetings, worksessions, and special public meetings. Such notice must be reasonably p. 1 HB 2741calculated to provide meaningful notice to the public of any portcommission proceeding; (b) Notice of special public meetings must be delivered to eachlocal newspaper of general circulation, to each local radio station,and to each local television station; and (c) A port district must maintain an internet web site thatconspicuously posts the meeting notice information required under thissection. (3) The port commission shall by resolution adopt rules governingthe transaction of its business consistent with the requirements ofthis section and chapter 42.30 RCW.
